text:
Skilled, gentle touch, clean, short waiting list.
Finished the job, no need for touch-ups.
Reasonable price.
This isn't a free 30 baht clinic.

restaurant_name: สุขุมทันตคลีนิก โดยทันตแพทย์สุขุม กัมทรทิพย์
text:
This is an old dental clinic in the area. I've been using their services for 20 years, since I was a child. I always get my teeth cleaned and fillings done here. The owner/doctor oversees the clinic herself.

The doctor is kind, very professional, highly experienced, and has a gentle touch. Teeth cleaning is painless and doesn't cause bleeding. The work is quick but meticulous. They don't push sales, only recommending necessary treatments and being honest about what's not needed. The prices are very reasonable, cheaper than those in shopping malls, and they accept social security insurance.

restaurant_name: สุขุมทันตคลีนิก โดยทันตแพทย์สุขุม กัมทรทิพย์
text:
I recently had my wisdom tooth extracted by the dentist.
It's a small clinic with complete equipment,
even having an X-ray machine for pre-extraction checks.
The dentist was explaining, chatting, polite, friendly, and gave excellent additional advice.

The price is standard.
*Correction: It seems the prices have increased and it looks like they're charging full price for everything now. 😂

text: He lacks empathy. A good dentist would understand that if you pay for treatment and it's not free under the National Health Security Office (NHSO), you wouldn't be sent back to a doctor referred by the government agency.
